item.title: Apple Considers Third‑Party AI Apps to Grow Services
item.description: Apple’s CFO hints at using third‑party AI apps on the App Store to offset services slowdown amid gaming slump, pressure, and Epic’s lawsuit.

item.title: Apple Bars Under‑18 Use of Dating & AI Companion Apps
item.description: Apple's new App Store rules force dating and AI companion apps to carry an 18+ rating, add descriptors, and flag location‑sharing for child safety.

item.title: Apple’s App Store Pushes Premium Games: Why It Matters
item.description: Apple’s App Store reports a surge in premium games, as indie hits and console ports benefit from new dev tools, Creative Assets and flexible pricing.

item.title: Apple Could Lose Commission on Third‑Party App Sales
item.description: Apple’s filing admits it may earn zero commission from apps sold via alternative stores, igniting fresh legal battles and reshaping the app economy.

item.title: Apple App Store Commission Declines 18% in 2026
item.description: Apple’s App Store commission revenue fell 18% in 2026 after regulatory changes, impacting U.S., Brazil, and Japan markets and weighing on Services growth.

item.title: Apple's Grip
item.description: Apple's control over iPhone apps in Brazil is loosening, what does this mean for developers and users?
